params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Malphite}} {{tip|shields}} himself equal to a portion of {{as|his '''maximum''' health}}, which refreshes after a few seconds without taking damage.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate - Shard of the Monolith:}} '''Malphite''' gains increased percentage [[size]] equal to {{as|8% of his '''total''' armor}}, capped at 35% increased size at {{as|{{fd|437.5}} armor}}.
params.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Granite Shield:}} '''Malphite''' grants himself a {{tip|shield}} equal to {{as|10% of his '''maximum''' health}}. The shield lasts until it is broken, and replenishes to full strength after a few seconds of not taking damage.
params.notes:
* '''Malphite's''' increased size is affected by his base armor and growth, but also reduced by {{ii|Black Cleaver}}. His increased size does not consider {{ais|Thunderclap|Malphite}} '''bonus''' armor.
** The bonus '''will''' become a size reduction if '''Malphite''' is dropped to ''negative'' armor values.
* ''Granite Shield'' does not refresh its cooldown from damage that is mitigated by {{tip|shield|shields}}.

blurb.plain: Innate: Malphite shields himself equal to a portion of his maximum health, which refreshes after a few seconds without taking damage.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Malphite}} sends a shard to the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slows}} them for a few seconds.
params.blurb2: He also gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for the same duration.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Malphite''' sends a shard to the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slows}} them for 3 seconds upon impact.
params.description2: '''Malphite''' also gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} equal to the {{tt|raw|before movement speed soft caps}} amount of {{as|movement speed}} the target lost from the slow for the duration.
params.notes:
* The rock spawns {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 100 units in front of '''Malphite'''.
* '''Malphite''' will gain the bonus movement speed for the full duration as long as ''Seismic Shard'' impacts the target.
** Both a buff shown in the hotbar and duration bar above the ability icon will indicate the remaining duration.
* ''Seismic Shard's'' movement speed gain is based off the target's movement speed {{as|raw '''total''' movement speed}} lost at the time of impact.
** For example, targets that were already {{tip|slow|slowed}} by another effect will grant '''Malphite''' diminished movement speed, while targets that are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by another effect after being impacted by ''Seismic Shard'' will not.
** {{tip|Slow resist|Slow-resistant}} and {{tip|slow-immune}} targets will reduce or nullify '''Malphite's''' gain.
{{Unit-targeted cancel conditions}}

params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} {{ci|Malphite}} gains {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}}, tripled while {{ai|Granite Shield|Malphite}} is active.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Malphite's''' next basic attack within a few seconds is empowered to gain {{sti|'''bonus''' range}} and deal {{as|'''additional''' physical damage}}.
params.blurb3: Additionally, '''Malphite's''' basic attacks for the next few seconds trigger a cone in the direction of the target that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit.
params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Malphite''' gains {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}}, tripled while ''{{ai|Granite Shield|Malphite}}'' is active.
params.leveling: {{st|Bonus Armor|{{as|{{ap|10 to 30}}% armor}}|Increased Bonus Armor|{{as|{{ap|10*3 to 30*3}}% armor}}}}
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Malphite''' empowers his next basic attack within 6 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|50 '''bonus''' range}}, and deal {{ccs|{{as|'''additional''' physical damage}}|physical}} {{tip|on-hit}}.
params.description3: Additionally, '''Malphite's''' basic attacks {{tip|on-hit}} for the next 5 seconds are empowered to trigger a cone in the direction of the target that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit.
params.notes:
* The main target is dealt {{tip|basic damage}}, though without {{tip|applies lifesteal|applying life steal}}, while the cone deals {{tip|area damage|area}} non-{{tip|proc damage|proc}} damage without applying {{tip|spell effects}}.
** The cone will trigger {{cai|E|Jax}} damage reduction, {{ri|Cheap Shot}}, {{ri|Conqueror}}, {{ri|Dark Harvest}}, {{ri|Electrocute}}, {{ri|Summon Aery}}, {{ii|Eclipse}}, {{ii|World Atlas}} enemy champion proc, and {{bi|Ocean Dragon Soul}}. 
*** It is also special cased to trigger {{ii|Tear of the Goddess}}.
** The cone does not benefit from {{iis|Spear of Shojin}} damage amp.
* The passive '''will''' amplify [[Armor_penetration#Reducing_armor|''negative'' armor]], too, if '''Malphite's''' armor is dropped that low.
* The passive's bonus {{as|armor}} {{tip|stacks multiplicatively}} with {{iis|Jak'Sho, The Protean}} {{nie|Voidborn Resilience}} and {{bi|Mountainous Vigor}} and stacks [[recursion|recursively]] with {{ri|Conditioning}}.<!--this last one may be outdated-->
* The empowered attack:
** Benefits from ''Thunderclap's'' cone effect.
** Prevents '''Malphite''' from casting {{ai|Seismic Shard|Malphite}} and {{ai|Ground Slam|Malphite}} during its windup.
** ''Cannot'' have its {{tip|attack windup|windup}} canceled by new movement or attack commands, or casting {{ai|Unstoppable Force|Malphite}}.
** ''Can'' have its windup canceled by casting {{ii|Hextech Rocketbelt}}.
* The cone starts from '''Malphite's''' location.
** Unlike similar spells, it does not deal its damage separately to the primary target of the attack(s); if the target is outside the [[area of effect]] when struck, it will not take the additional damage.
params.tips:
* Taking into account '''Malphite's''' {{as|'''base''' attack speed}} and attack speed growth, he'll be able to use up to 4-6 (levels 1-18) empowered attacks (including the initial one).
** With {{as|{{fd|2.5}} attack speed}}, he'll be able to use up to 12.<!--I'm too lazy to evergreen this and there's no way they would change his as-->
* The initial hit of this ability gains:
** {{fd|{{#expr:20/{{#var:ap}}}}}} damage per {{g|100}} worth of {{sti|AP|{{as|ability power}}}}.
** {{pp|{{#expr:15/{{#var:armor}}*(100+10)/100}} to {{#expr:15/{{#var:armor}}*(100+30)/100}}|1;2;3;4;5|showtype=false|round=3|changedisplay=true}} damage per {{g|100}} worth of {{as|{{sti|'''Armor'''}}|armor}} depending on the level of {{ai|Thunderclap|Malphite}}.
*** {{pp|{{#expr:15/{{#var:armor}}*(100+10*3)/100}} to {{#expr:15/{{#var:armor}}*(100+30*3)/100}}|1;2;3;4;5|showtype=false|round=3|changedisplay=true}} damage per {{g|100}} worth of {{as|{{sti|'''Armor'''}}|armor}} depending on the level of {{ai|Thunderclap|Malphite}} while {{ai|Granite Shield|Malphite}} is active.
* The splash damage from this ability gains:
** {{fd|{{#expr:30/{{#var:ap}}}}}} damage per {{g|100}} worth of {{sti|AP|{{as|ability power}}}}.
** {{pp|{{#expr:15/{{#var:armor}}*(100+10)/100}} to {{#expr:15/{{#var:armor}}*(100+30)/100}}|1;2;3;4;5|showtype=false|round=3|changedisplay=true}} damage per {{g|100}} worth of {{as|{{sti|'''Armor'''}}|armor}} depending on the level of {{ai|Thunderclap|Malphite}}.
*** {{pp|{{#expr:15/{{#var:armor}}*(100+10*3)/100}} to {{#expr:15/{{#var:armor}}*(100+30*3)/100}}|1;2;3;4;5|showtype=false|round=3|changedisplay=true}} damage per {{g|100}} worth of {{as|{{sti|'''Armor'''}}|armor}} depending on the level of {{ai|Thunderclap|Malphite}} while {{ai|Granite Shield|Malphite}} is active.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Malphite}} {{tip|dashes}} with {{tip|displacement immunity}} to the target location. Upon arrival, he deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and briefly {{tip|airborne|knocks them up}}.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|{{tip|displacement immunity|nolink=true}}:}} The dash cannot be deterred by {{tip|crowd control}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Malphite''' {{tip|dashes}} with {{tip|displacement immunity}} to the target location. Upon arrival, he deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|airborne|knocks them up}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
params.notes:
* ''Unstoppable Force'' has no minimum dash range.
* The dash speed can be up-to doubled if ''Unstoppable Force'' is targeted at the middle of a wall so that his destination ends up on the other side.
** It will be decreased if his destination ends up closer to him than his target location.
* If '''Malphite''' dies during his {{tip|dash}}, the ability cancels.
** If the dash is interrupted without '''Malphite''' dying, for instance when he enters {{tip|resurrection}} during ''Unstoppable Force'', he halts and the ability instead affects enemies at the stopped location.

blurb.plain: Active: Malphite dashes with displacement immunity to the target location. Upon arrival, he deals magic damage to nearby enemies and briefly knocks them up.

blurb4.plain: displacement immunity: The dash cannot be deterred by crowd control.

description.plain: Active: Malphite dashes with displacement immunity to the target location. Upon arrival, he deals magic damage to nearby enemies and knocks them up for 1.5 seconds.
